entries.land_location_as_stated: on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts
entries.description: A 100-acre farm with cranberry bog and gardens on Silver Lake in Massachusetts, lived on by a couple. Offers camping, farmwork experience, and apprenticeships to lesbian women and children while working to organize a land trust.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-3826. My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children. We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phonecall, preferably a letter.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('My partner & I are the only residents'); working to establish a land trust but not yet held in one. Lesbian women inferred from directory context and 'women'; 'children' gives Girl children and Boy children. Focus on Farming/self-sufficiency from 'farmwork experience', 'cranberry bog & gardens'. Focus on Workshops/education from 'longer term apprenticeships'. Rejection of lesbian separatism noted ('We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach'). Mailing address is a PO box, so land street and zip left blank; land state inferred from 'South Shore area of Massachusetts'.

entries.description: An intentional community on 113 acres in the Maine mountains with four resident lesbians, offering camping, hiking, and parcels for sale or building. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and new members.
entries.raw_text: WOMONGROUND Rt 1, Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987. 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking. Will answer all letters promptly. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'women working and living on the land' and actively welcoming 'new members/residents'. Rural route address copied to land address. Residents count of 4 taken from '4 lesbians' combined with 'women working and living on the land'. Accepted groups explicitly stated: 'girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land'.

entries.description: A 20-acre parcel in Vermont with two dyke-built dwellings owned by a collective. None of the owners currently reside there, and the collective is seeking lesbian renters.
entries.raw_text: GENEROUS EARTH LAND Box 51A, Hinesburg, VT 05461. 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity. None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on ownership by a 'dyke collective'. Residents is 0 because 'None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets.' Accepted groups coded as Lesbian women from 'Interested in dyke renters.' PO box mailing address, so land street and zip left blank; land state inferred from VT mailing address.

entries.description: A working homestead farm in Vermont with an all-lesbian maple sugar bush, draft horse, dairy goats, and organic food raising. Offers retreat space, ski weekends, work exchange, and workshops, and welcomes community members to lease land and build cabins or tipis.
entries.raw_text: GREENHOPE Box 226, E Hardwick, VT 05836. (802)533-7772. At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends — $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush — the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We are vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here.
